scope: Actual App/CommandPalette/LibraryMode components and input; simulated native search. Grammar and real files tested separately.
checks: Library search shares the query grammar and shows an actionable incomplete-phrase error rather than a fake empty result
Actual command panel returns TXT/JSON through the shared endpoint; scope and query controls fit all six styles and narrow windows with normal motion
Short narrow windows keep instructions visible; keyboard selection scrolls into view through a long result list
Late native responses cannot overwrite a newer query or command-mode results
Loading, unavailable libraries, partial results, invalid phrases and genuine empty results remain distinct
Closing invalidates pending requests; reopening clears the query without stale-result flash
Cross-library open blocks unsaved drafts; a clean open switches to the configured library and opens in the main workspace
Escape closes the panel after scope selection or a rejected click without refocusing the input; pending library persistence is announced and cannot be canceled or double-submitted mid-write
